checkpoint_selection: per-image maximum global-direction population variance divided by average variance across feature directions; normalized local features and reference; native feature dimension; earliest native block on ties; drop at selected block input; select once before attack

checkpoint_score_normalization.denominator: total local population variance / native feature dimension
checkpoint_score_normalization.precision: float64 normalized geometry from float32 features

checkpoint_tie_break: earliest block in native forward order
drop_count_rounding: total ratio rounded to 12 decimals; max(1, round(native token count * ratio))
patch_score_reference: final CLS after class-attention, before final LayerNorm; raw local block outputs
